findings.evidence: “Check repeated rule-of-three phrasing, ‘not just X but Y’ contrasts, synonym cycling ... and repeated transition words” illustrates familiar editing advice. The 28-line Core diagnostics section is predominantly activation, while the shorter evidence-protection section supplies the more consequential specialized constraints.
findings.fix: Condense familiar cliché, filler, rhythm, and mechanics inventories. Retain the contextual exemptions, exact-match protections, author-register preservation, and distinction between intended and measured benefits, supported by a few fact-preserving examples.

findings.evidence: The Generic Positive Conclusions example replaces unsupported praise with “The acquisition expands the company into a new market,” although the before-text supplies neither an acquisition nor a new market. The emoji example similarly turns “Users prefer simplicity” into “User research showed a preference for simplicity.” Following the optional style/filler branch therefore models adding evidence, contrary to the main protocol.
findings.fix: Rewrite the catalog's before/after pairs so every factual claim in an after-text is supported by its before-text.
